content.comment_body: I have a small project and would like advice on the best approach. I need to connect two sensors—one PT100 and one high-pressure sensor, both with 4-20mA outputs. Should I choose the [product_name] AM2 or the [product_name] AM2 PT100?

Hello, If I understand correctly, your PT100 sensor has a transducer converting the signal to 4-20mA. In this case, you should use the [product_name] AM2 module. The [product_name] AM2 PT100 is intended for direct connection to PT100 sensors. [url]
